notes.title: Patch v1.7 is now live!
notes.content:
Here the patch 1.7 that brings new updates and corrects some bugs. Here the full changelog:

update: the "Ravenous beast" is a bit more strong (only in HARD mode)
update: the "Death" is a bit more dangerous  (only in HARD mode)
update: after the first scrolls sacrifice, dungeon lord want more scrolls (only in HARD mode)
update: at workshop, you need lees shards in order to repair a shield
update: no more followers when you've almost reached the dungeon's exit (3 steps far)
update: less torches... more traps
update: you can see more easily the "enchanted golden key" into the hud
update: your God will be less likely to give malevolent blessings if you have low health
update: ravenous beast has a chance to damage your shield
update: a bit more chance to find rooms with 3 bags, and bit less chance to find empty rooms
update: with homeless character, you will receive less gold when use the "ask for mercy" special trait
update: the action "show your wrath" will help you to combat the poison status alteration
update: the item "vampire's fang" is visible on hud while triggered
update: you will receive more help (just a bit) from PANIC event
update: stranger guy/girl sells at a bit higher price
update: improved egg

bugfix: the fight with the "ravenous beast" does not stop even if with 0 hp
bugfix: dungeon's lord "welcome gift" loop
bugfix: repositioned the window with "keys to press" after half dungeon (if mid-floor behaviour is selected)
bugfix: when in front of a "fairy", and you got the "rod-land" amiga disk, the game shows wrong values
bugfix: wrong tutorial arrow while "pursued by someone"

notes.title: "It's been a while"... UPDATE!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329403/04e568ec7ded16ff470cf8da50ba510cde86e0d6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Version 1.6 – 27 July 2025[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! It's been a while since RANDungeon was updated. Today's update fixes some annoying bugs that some players have encountered in recent weeks, as well as balancing some gameplay aspects.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's a list of the main changes:[/p][list][*][p]update: better behaviour for thieves while attacking[/p][/*][*][p]update: reduced the “medium upgrade kit” benefits[/p][/*][*][p]update: better behaviour of Dungeon’s Lord[/p][/*][*][p]update: cannot deposit gold if too close to the dungeon exit[/p][/*][*][p]minor update: adjusted one bgm volume level[/p][/*][*][p]minor update: modified depowering gun’s projectiles visual[/p][/*][*][p]minor update: modified break-risk percentages visual[/p][/*][*][p]minor update: less gold received while using “frighten” special trait[/p][/*][*][p]minor update: semi-transparent walking bars removed[/p][/*][*][p]minor update: with warrior, you will be alerted if cannot upgrade your weapon[/p][/*][*][p]bugfix: after the “altar sacrifice” card, sometimes wrong card will be shown[/p][/*][*][p]bugfix: you obtain the reward at gate (dungeon 3) even without the correct word[/p][/*][*][p]bugfix: poisoned text will appear while playing gambling[/p][/*][*][p]bugfix: ancestral horn issue[/p][/*][*][p]bugfix: better sync of sprint sound[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]It's possible that further changes to the game will be released in the coming days. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Major update 1.5 - MacOS version released!
notes.content:
This update brings many updates and bugfixes, and also introduce the game to the macOS systems. The game is now enjoyable also on Steam Deck. Here the changelog:

important update: save cooldown – now you can save only after 5 turns (10 if in hard mode)
important update: mid-floor behaviour – now at half dungeon you can choose your exploration behaviour (only on hard mode)
update: panic can be triggered one time per floor
update: lizards left less gold when defeated
update: slighly changed the rare “bubble bobble” floppy disk effects – now increases… oh, I can tell you 😉
update: hard mode is more challenging (added more penalties, expecially on combat behaviours)
update: the maximum penalty for losing yourself into dungeon (when examine) is 2 additional cards (3 for hard mode)
update: now examine/investigate can end earlier, based on dungeon (less chance to lose the way into dungeon)
update: dungeon lord got a surprise (if he thinks you are too strong – only for hard mode)
update: slightly better rewards at dungeon end
update: new special item added – magical flute (increase inspiration effects)
update: depowering gun now have 5 shots instead of 4
update: thieves steal more money
update: better potions icons
update: save/load portraits now indicate floor and hard mode
update: better “pursuer” distribution (now level based)
update: extra strike roulette is available from 20 hp instead of 50 hp
update: added “the collector” card – sell/buy the amiga floppy disks
update: with each prayer, the recovery of health points will be less
update: armor can be damaged and destroyed (except for ancient armor) but cost less gold
update: “vampire’s fang” does not work when on 0 health
update: increased chance to find magical scrolls in early game
update: added new treasure chest reward (the farmachologist kit) and all kits are now balanced
update: treasure chest’s rewards are dungeon based
update: executioner is a bit dangerous in hard mode
update: new percentage limits for sweep/charge/defensive attacks
update: better “boulder path block” event
bugfix: fixed a wrong amiga floppy disk description
bugfix: a merchant showing the wrong armor
bugfix: berserk extra defense bonus not correctly applied

notes.title: Huge update - v1.4 released!
notes.content:
The [b]BIG HUGE UPDATE[/b] is finally here! The [u]version 1.4[/u] completely changes the rules of RANDungeon, so update the game as fast as you can!

Here the changelog:

major update: new ‘draw card’ system for a better gameplay experience
important update: new menu called “the way of faith” (new actions: wrath/meditate)
important update: new “fight menu” mechanics and “extra damage” roulette
update: ‘survival kit’ and ‘first aid kit’ can be found into treasure chest
update: in ‘hard mode’ the trap damage will increase
update: added a new trap called ‘electrocution’
update: the further you progress in the dungeons, the more traps there will be
update: better fatigue system
update: new mechanics for “closed door” event
update: the chance to find “special items” is now well balanced
update: the more tired you are, the more difficult it will be to escape the pursuer
update: discharging fury now you can recover more health (recover is based on current health)
update: new “inspiration” event – sometimes now you can choose what you wanna search into dungeons
update: “inspiration” event is influenced by missing “fury” (less fury, more inspiration cause not thinking about combat)
update: eluding a pursuer slightly increase the fury gauge
update: under “berserk” status alteration, you cannot perform “rest for a while” action
update: no more turn penalty for assassin’s “frighten” special skill
update: must have a minimum of 300 gold to use shards converter (400 gold if in hard mode)
update: the “gnome” have a slightly increased chance to left his box
update: now you get tired more easily, but by resting you will recover more stamina (maybe few hp) and don’t lose a turn
update: can no longer trash torches/food, but “panic” is now easier to get (now the positive effects of “panic” are greater)
update: armor “hud” icons modified
update: tutorial page has removed from the game (step-by-step tutorial is still available)
update: save/load system now shows the character’s portrait (and also can load in mid-game)
update: fury “raise” faster when defeating any enemy (without suffering any hit) and when below 20 hp
update: less “fury” penalty if hit by enemy or unable to defeat him
update: new windowskin and enhanced save system
update: better sync for audio animations
update: “lucky charm” nerfed. Now it will increase the gold/ancient shards found by 1/3
QOL update: font size have been increased for better readability on steam deck
QOL update: a balloon hover icon indicates that you cannot deposit gold
bugfix: wrong fury charging when suffer an extra attack by enemy
bugfix: the homeless ‘hungry-man’ special got wrong description
bugfix: using ‘Depowering Gun’ if choosing the corruption
bugfix: now you can’t get lost at the beginning of the dungeon or when you reach the exit
bugfix: not shaking card for pursuers
bugfix: wrong sprint from the “executioner” at dungeon end
bugfix: discharging the fury gauge, the hp went over its maximum capacity (for a short time)
bugfix: sometimes the weapon degrades after a charge
bugfix: some issue related to icons after using upgrade kits
bugfix: the “sorcerer” will hit even when don’t
bugfix: sometimes the merchant of potions leaves too earlier
bugfix: the warrior character does not start with the “ring mail armor” equipped
bugfix: attack/defense hud icon disappear after upgrading at workshop
bugfix: not set correctly the “decision card” choice if simultaneously find a new weapon/shield
bugfix: the chest icon in dungeon 3 is wrongly positioned

The official changelog is available here: [url=https://www.viscocat.com/randungeon/changelog/]www.viscocat.com[/url]

notes.title: Update patch v1.3 is here!
notes.content:
This patch brings some useful enhancements with it. Here the changelog:

game update: you can find more health potions into dungeons
game update: the chances of drawing an event card are slightly increased
game update: the chances of finding weapons are slightly increased
game update: after a rest, the enemy will approach you
game update: windowed mode is selectable from the ingame menu
game update: the warrior character now can also self-heal the berserk status
bugfix: the “rest for a while” action have a short cooldown

notes.title: Bugfix 1.21 - (bug happens)
notes.content:
This patch is [b]absolutely mandatory[/b] and fixes some [u]terrible and known bugs[/u] in the game!
Some of these prevented the game from loading properly on some computers. Hard mode is finally working too.

Thanks for your patience! Here the changelog (minor changes will not be listed below):

- bugfix: a bug prevent to unlock the hardmode
- bugfix: a bug prevent to use correctly the "frighten" active skill (assassin character)
- bugfix: a bug prevent to show progress after dungeon win

notes.title: Patch update v1.1 with bug fixing
notes.content:
The update patch v1.1 is now live. This is an important update because a bug prevent the game to tracks correctly your progress, so this update is mandatory! Here the changelog:

update: cards now enters covered (red cards are monsters, yellow cards are unforseen events)
update: sometimes you will trigger a trap when grabbing new weapons or shields (but can disarm it)
update: increased chances (just a bit) to find weapons or shields
bugfix: the game don't track correctly your progress
bugfix: hit&run behaviour not correctly deactivated
bugfix: turrican floppy disk issue
bugfix: wrong ravenous beast behaviour on food launch
bugfix: scroll of "christmas" will show wrong icons
bugfix: music volume change after descending to a new dungeon
bugfix: berserk status balloon icon not shown while fighting dungeon lord
bugfix: fixed some hud icons (only for two player mode)
bugfix: equipped items not available into intentory (only for two player mode)

notes.title: The update patch v1.0.8 is now live!
notes.content:
This update brings some balancement for two players mode and new improvements to cards and menu.
Here the changelog:

update: now into “pray” menu you can find “rest” action
update: the workshop is less expensive
update: balanced the two player mode
update: added a secondary sabotage roulette for player two
update: better and faster “higher/lower” minigame
update: now bgm volume is saved on game exit
update: in two players mode, no golden key is needed to open treasure chests displayed on hud
visual update: new cards for witches and gnomes
QOL update: better “Shard converter” menu
QOL update: the fast forward function has been disabled
bugfix: wrong “hit & run” icon shown
bugfix: wrong “sorcerer” card shown
bugfix: improved some translation

notes.title: Quick patch v1.0.7rev1 is online!
notes.content:
With the imminent release of v1.0.8 patch, the mandatory patch 1.0.7rev1 brings some correction to the game. Here some changes:

QOL update: better "Shard converter" menu
QOL update: the fast forward function has been disabled
bugfix: wrong "sorcerer" card shown
bugfix: improved some translation

notes.title: Patch v1.0.7 is now live!
notes.content:
The update patch [b]version 1.0.7[/b] is now live – 30 December 2024 (published)
This patch brings many changes and an important improvement to hud scripting code. If you got any kind of issues (for example empty hud), just erase your savegame (you will find it into "save" folder into root directory of RANDungeon).

major update: optimized the HUD script (savegames will be obsolete from this point, [u]erase[/u] it in case of issues with hud)
update: the screen is a bit “green” bordered if special trait is available
update: the chances to draw an event card are a bit increased
update: now you can melt ancient shards, obtaining torches (by using shard converter)
update: better “progress page” shown at every game end/death (and before every single run – optional)
update: new “sorcerer” card, he is dangerous and able to curse your gear
update: some potions are more expensive
update: food supplies and torches now got an indicator under hud icons
update: the presence of the “executioner” now can scare and confuse you (and also can tire you)
update: new “gnome” card, gives torches in exchange of food and maybe drop a special item
update: now “burglary tools” can be used to open treasure chests
bugfix: fixed some gauge speed

Official changelog page: [url=https://www.viscocat.com/randungeon/changelog/]www.viscocat.com/changelog[/url]

notes.title: The patch v1.0.6 has been released!
notes.content:
The new version 1.0.6 (24 December 2024) brings some news. Here the changelog:

update: better ‘hole’ event
update: can purchase 2 items at a time from most of merchants
update: can do a sprint anytime (sprint is also used to flee from chasing enemies)
update: can be chased by enemies (not monsters)
update: can discard food supplies and torches from the inventory (useful in “desperates” situations)
update: now can rest for a while (from equipment menu) and recover some health points
update: fatigue now builds up faster when not defeating the enemies (it does not apply to barbarian)
update: new attack behaviour called “Hit and run” (can run after a fight, but consumes random resources or health points)
update: now sprints will cost more stamina (but can sprint after a fight)
update: implementing inventory (now potions can be stored into inventory)
update: auto hide mouse cursor after 6 seconds
bugfix: unable to go back main menu after player mode selection

notes.title: The update v1.0.5 is now live!
notes.content:
[h2]This update brings the first QoL fixes and other changes:[/h2]
[b]
update: blur effect when on low health
update: bigger mouse cursor
update: auto hide mouse cursor after 4 seconds
update: skippable intro
update: better "lotus" and "sensible" floppy

bugfix: "lotus" and "sensible" floppy disks issue
[/b]
